spans.s:
Bright.
f. (-भा)
1 Light, lustre, radiance, splendour.
2

Distinguished merit.
4 A species of the Kṛti metre.
E.
शुभ to shine, aff. अच, fem. aff. टाप्.

mfn. (-कृत्)
Beautifying.
m. (-कृत्)
1 The thirty-sixth year of the Hindu cycle.
2 Marking-nut plant.
E.
शोभ handsome, and कृन् what makes.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Beautiful, handsome.
2 Shining, splendid.
3 Richly dressed or ornamented.
4 Propitious, auspicious.
5 Virtuous, moral, decorous, good.
m. (-नः)
1 The fifth

A planet.
3 Burnt-offering for auspicious results.
n. (-नं)
1 A lotus.
2 Shining, being splendid or handsome.
E.
शुभ to shine, aff. युच्.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

n. (-तं)
Virtuous practice.
E.
शोभन, and आचरित done.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Fair, splendid, shining.
E.
शुभ to shine, &c., शानच् aff.

m. (-नः)
A tree, commonly Sajinā or Sahajnā, (Hyperanthera morunga); the legumes, blossoms, and leaves are esculent, and the root of the young tree is used as a substitute for horse-radish: in medicine the root is used as a rubefacient externally, as a stimulant internally, and the expressed oil of the seeds is employed to relieve arthritic pains, &c.
E.
शोभा beauty, अञ्ज to pervade or anoint, and ल्युट् or युच् aff; also शौभाञ्जन and सोभाञ्जन, &c.

m. (-नः)
A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga); see शोभाञ्जन.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Beautified, decorated.
E.
शुभ to shine, क्त aff.
